evidenceBoundary: Real browser renders of current application components. Synthetic data and isolated local query/auth/navigation adapters. Not evidence of sign-in, authorization, live records, provider calls or production deployment. Build styles and Geist/Noto fonts are reused without restyling the app. The visible provenance banner belongs only to this harness.
reviewMethod: Direct visual inspection of each original PNG at original resolution; no contact sheets or image substitutions.

evidenceLimits: Synthetic documentation fixtures show actual components with writes disabled. They do not prove authenticated access, provider execution, persistence, or live production data.
Only the viewport and state in each original PNG were visually inspected. Images do not prove interaction, keyboard behavior, or content outside the captured viewport.

Account desktop section navigation is covered in English, Arabic, and Kannada, light and dark. Team member actions and production forms are not present in this fixture manifest and remain outside this review.
admin-pilot-phone.png shows part of a wide material-report table. The Difference kg column beyond the viewport and horizontal scrolling behavior are not proved by this image.
Existing product wording about payments, SMS, and compliance was treated as baseline content, not as a new layout defect or evidence of provider execution.
summary: All 126 manifest originals were visually inspected at original resolution. No new material layout defect was found in the submitted fixture states. File hashes and manifest hash remained unchanged during the review.
dispositionScope: The 126 visually inspected synthetic fixture layouts only; not a whole-platform release or live integration verdict.
